content: Flower Hospital is a public healthcare facility located in Sylvania, Ohio, and operates as part of the ProMedica Health System. It is designated as a Level III trauma center and employs approximately 1,500 healthcare professionals who provide medical care to patients across its 297 inpatient beds. The hospital was originally established in 1910 by Stevens Warren Flower in memory of his late wife, Ellen. Initially constructed near his residence in downtown Toledo, Ohio, the hospital was later relocated to Sylvania, Ohio, in 1975. Flower Hospital offers a range of amenities for patients, visitors, and staff, including a cafeteria, a gift shop, internet access, a library, and pastoral care services.
